name: Messina router hop() recursive VAA re-emission (Opulous OPUL)
summary: The Messina router on Avalanche, the Wormhole emitter trusted by every destination bridge, re-publishes any verified VAA through hop() without checking its emitter, source/destination network or target chain. Attackers fed the router's own output VAAs back into hop() hundreds of times, turning single deposits into many distinct claimable VAAs that released OPUL and other escrowed tokens on Arbitrum, Ethereum, BSC, Base and Polygon.

loss.notes: Merged campaigns 2026-03-13/14 (Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum), 03-24/25 (DBD, 0x53b8eba7), 03-30 (BUBBLE, 0x7e358874), 05-07 (Mog/BOBO, 0x6551de33) and 09-22 (BUBBLE/RLB/DEGEN, 0xe33112d9) against the same router implementation. Liquid escrowed assets are measured as escrow releases to the attacker set minus attacker deposits into the same escrow, at incident price. OPUL is an unbacked float on each chain and was dumped with large price impact, so it, BOBO, DBD and the September BUBBLE are valued only by realised DEX proceeds net of attacker purchases; roughly 80M OPUL sent to exchange deposit addresses or left unsold is not valued, so the figure is an onchain lower bound. Treasury fees are excluded and later recoveries are not deducted.

ageReset.description: Latest pre-exploit Upgraded event installed the router implementation whose hop() re-emits self-emitted and same-network VAAs.

limitations: The router implementation source is unverified; the failure identity is established from the traced call path, decoded calldata, storage diff and replay behaviour recorded in source-7.

sources.note: Reviewed admission, root cause and earliest exercise. Messina router 0x0f7ba1632447ded5dd18ceb65755e3d36aff4587 on Avalanche (ERC1967 proxy, implementation 0xf014a33bd8ab261174519735ee672813bf5e0906, unverified) is the Wormhole emitter that every destination Messina bridge trusts for chain 6: eth_call bridgeContracts(uint16)(6) returns the router on Ethereum 0xc74303104e4aa5833a59767d59e958f4a0f308d4, Arbitrum 0x537816fbb8ec6078fb8b51f3bc35d5444edcb361 (verified BridgeImplementationV2 behind it; _completeTransfer checks only valid VM, verifyBridgeVM emitter match and per-VM-hash replay) and BSC 0xfa5b25a3a2faf613285afe6f74ed9a81387164d9, registered by registerChain 0x65bb3ea7 in 0xfdd29867cd889e51bbba98d1b719b24b9608ef2bca02aa4b391abe11a256558a (2023-06-22), 0x23e84ab4e2bb0368377115d0f0a4ce7585860dff82ff63334d0c23d2c4f62008 (2023-06-22) and 0x3620c2ed185625dc2bff72fe95938cfb2f752751dc5cdfc35bbd894b9b224659 (2023-07-19); bridgeContracts(2) on Ethereum is zero. Router selector 0xff22310b = hop(bytes vm,uint32 nonce,bytes srcNetwork,bytes dstNetwork) (cast selectors on the implementation). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 80281812, tx index 11): EOA 0x7e358874949d207977b4fb7c82b4d2ff5c77bbc1 -> router hop, delegatecall to the implementation, Wormhole core 0x54a8e5f9c4cba08f9943965859f6c34eaf03e26c parseAndVerifyVM, messageFee, publishMessage(uint32,bytes,uint8). Calldata: srcNetwork=dstNetwork="WORMHOLE"; the VM (hash keccak256(keccak256(body)) 0x71c970daa1433c1700dadfed0691728ca779694bdc44b71ae66bf907ce46a93d) is emitter chain 2 / Ethereum router 0x00c0f1c37edbc92b1c23b350b89775b5324009b6, sequence 1744, transfer payload 24950000 (8-dec) WETH chain 2 to 0x7e35... toChain 2, i.e. a same-chain deposit made 8 minutes earlier (WETH escrow receipt 0x4569398000fce11e824d518c12f3d7d80d1b0d27d415e73369c8fc1066a506b7) that no destination accepts directly. Receipt log 36: LogMessagePublished(sender=router, sequence 2417) republishing the identical payload under the trusted router emitter. prestateTracer diffMode writes only router slots keccak256(vmHash,104)=1 (consumed) and keccak256(vmHash,105)=0x971; hop checks neither emitter (it accepts its own VMs), nor src!=dst network, nor payload toChain. Source-2 (next hop, block 80282072) feeds the router's own sequence-2417 VM and emits 2418; every emitted VM has a fresh hash, so recursion yields unlimited claimable copies of one deposit, while resubmitting an identical VM reverts (e.g. VM 0x68e6a0bb50406b5e6aa3406d9c98c14cddcdd0aba71411a772de3fd87bdc8143: 0x470369f6459710c473de3aab88dc7489783ab139f7f58ac82f298284c2669f52 ok, 0x2859e451c1d6a497d85e22fa302b94a2ecca77fa59396fab614d0246f999f952 and 0xbd566953fbb46aeef70f173fcec39ff7a0aa993709aea9098be84eb4cbc4b0f1 revert). Source-10 (Ethereum block 24648389, idx 191) redeems router sequence 2417 releasing 0.2495 WETH from escrow 0xd3c09c07ed5371ca76511ad1ff4cf357d7dbc108. Earliest-use scan: Etherscan V2 account.txlist for the router, chainid 43114, blocks 0..95906406 in three pages (0..80281811, 79000000..81500000, 81500000..latest) = 1327 txs. The 18 pre-anchor hop calls (2025-01-22..2025-07-14) are all by 0x40867f98e70e85754ce5808ba48cd0590593bed2 with src!=dst (5 WORMHOLE->MESSINA of Arbitrum-router VMs, 13 MESSINA->WORMHOLE of Messina-network emitter 20029 VMs); none hops a router-emitted or same-network VM. From source-1 on there are 1293 hop calls (1260 successful, 33 reverted), all WORMHOLE->WORMHOLE: of the successful ones 1127 consume earlier hop outputs, 66 consume router-emitted Avalanche-bridge deposits (chain roots) and 67 consume external-router VMs (chains 5:38, 2:22, 4:4, 23:2, 30:1). Campaigns: 2026-03-13 11:54..03-14 17:55 (0x7e35.. then Arbitrum wallets; Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum), 03-24..03-25 (0x53b8eba7.., DBD Polygon<->Ethereum), 03-30 (0x7e35.., BUBBLE), 05-07 (0x6551de33.., Mog/BOBO), 09-22 10:10..10:37 (0xe33112d9.., BUBBLE/RLB/DEGEN, last hop source-11). Wormhole LogMessagePublished logs with topic1=router, blocks 80270000..96339248 (1368 logs, no RPC errors) and TransferRedeemed(uint16,bytes32,uint64) topic 0xcaf280c8cfeba144da67230d9b009c8f868a75bac9a528fa0474be1ba317c169 with topic1=6, topic2=router on Ethereum (from 24644820), Arbitrum (441177271), BSC (86252794), Base (43285326), Polygon (84119983) to head give 1193 redemptions of hop-emitted sequences (Arbitrum 742, Ethereum 311, BSC 130, Base 9, Polygon 1). Permissionless calls, no privileged or key action, EVM code defect.

Reviewed identity and complete age history. Router proxy 0x0f7ba1632447ded5dd18ceb65755e3d36aff4587 created by 0x467d8b5401296194c60fdd978a293ec09e431228 in source-3 (block 31608297, idx 7; eth_getCode empty at 31608296; proxy runtime keccak 0xaf279b722f829025c13f69ed53423943cc2ee5cb4d6ae8b241047e45efcf5a73 at 31608297 and 80281811). eth_getLogs Upgraded topic 0xbc7cd75a20ee27fd9adebab32041f755214dbc6bffa90cc0225b39da2e5c2d3b on the proxy, blocks 31608297..80281811 in 2M-block chunks: exactly three events: 0x7227bdcf2b706668529991015023c40b958ef1ea (source-3, log 10), 0x936335192a2fb493cb913a0f4c1721f3ceee1704 (0xba30416d9f9daa27a18bdc23f42cf9a04e7b0cce8526aacd9ce380e51e3eeddc, block 55601761, log 4), 0xf014a33bd8ab261174519735ee672813bf5e0906 (source-4, block 56234633, idx 2, log 1, 2025-01-23T11:09:36Z). EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc = 0x9363.. at 56234632 and 0xf014.. at 56234633 and 80281811. Implementation created by the same deployer in source-5 (block 56194354, idx 0); eth_getCode empty at 56194353; runtime keccak 0x5edd16a2be4198457f182d29bb25b118447aeb1aa2b06a96bb07ad7246ce5f61 at 56194354 and 80281811; source is unverified (Etherscan getsourcecode empty), so the failure identity rests on the traced behaviour, selectors and storage diff in source-7. Configuration review: router txlist after the upgrade has only transferOwnership to Safe 0x197db76a6ae11801793000afe5ee1c7a4adc3a53 (0x8e613d81bafc7b52bf992d298e725e21fa9b3af8671e6b4b7c893cd7f031458a); the Safe's execTransaction list has no call to the router after 2025-01-23 (its only router call, 0x247457494b639ab0bcf35a0e4bab5eeec3ff8882006fc2603facaa5c6b94b168 at 10:43:55, returns ownership to the deployer for the upgrade); network registrations (b499af2e) date from 2023-06-21 and 2025-01-10; destination registrations of the router as chain-6 emitter date from 2023. No persistent value changed after the upgrade, so the latest code activation, the 0xf014 upgrade, is the age reset: 1773402871-1737630576 = 35772295 s.

Reviewed loss across all merged campaigns (reproduce with the attacker set in incident.attackerAddresses: the 15 successful post-anchor hop callers, reverted-hop caller and root recipient 0xaba0782cb9b8bb21fbfe2c951a887bbf8302973e, recipient 0x025031a6587faf0680b64bbbf211e20de4d4fc62, 0x65a8f07bd9a8598e1b5b6c0a88f4779dbc077675 (destination of 0x80fbb6cb's hopped root 23/631) and deposit funder 0xffe3d61a761c6d8b8ce00bc99ca6f589719926dc). Victim escrows are the per-token Messina escrows released by the 1193 hop redemptions listed in source-7. Liquid assets (DefiLlama confidence 0.99 and attacker sale prices within 3%) = escrow-to-attacker transfers minus attacker-to-escrow deposits (Etherscan tokentx address=escrow, contractaddress=token), fees to treasury 0x60be8c02e88284801dd02c18d7a80378474675bb excluded, valued at incident price: WETH escrow 0xd3c09c07.. 14.24102988 out - 0.2495 (bridge-wrapped deposit 0x45693980..) - 0.13451494 in; PEPE escrow 0xb299c4b63906a40067b85eb3184f506da0560be5 36216657750.0445 - 3541223220.68; wstETH 0x3a44848e151de243e4ea7f02d9953c4f5ef95445 0.33977146 - 0.02426939; Mog 0x52f30a551e5c51e926f5f2690247ac6044e32676 03-13 514188427.1572 - 128624281.3581 and 05-07 1540864688.7155 - 1230549509.4001; BSC WBNB 0xf662ffba820fbc89457d264d404fa5414047a108 8.31341112 - 0.32338649; Base DEGEN 0xa3039a86408c859adcc618dc6bf00cafb13ff8ad 1006790.76288 - 111932.8; RLB 0x1482039d0fc40ecc60a7f7c7050d000af8a6d79c 7123.882248 - 795.76; BUBBLE 0x441a2a0eba985e729ee9e0ab0c85c313757ba75a 03-30 27972 - 999. Tokens whose disposal moved the price or that lack a price use realised proceeds: per tx hash, attacker-set sales (token out to a non-escrow counterparty with non-exploit-token inflow) minus attacker purchases of the same token, from Etherscan tokentx/txlistinternal/txlist of every attacker address, restricted to windows [first hop-24h, last hop+72h] of each campaign; native/WETH legs valued at the nearest hourly DefiLlama point (source-19..23), stablecoins at par. OPUL is a pre-minted float on each chain (Arbitrum 500M minted to the deployer, ~492M placed in escrow 0x9b3fb3b1b5d994750d66dcc5ad7a6c7477b00bf7 in Dec 2023), so nominal releases are not valued: hop redemptions released 436209123.874 OPUL on Arbitrum, 37477500.022 on Ethereum (escrow 0xe9d3aa4be68896f91da4ede9517e95251af640e4), 1289995.741 on BSC (0x0c975dbeaea8404ca0e1aea4121d65cb76a614c3), matching source-6; DefiLlama OPUL fell from 0.00356 (03-13 00:00) to 0.00075 (03-15). OPUL realised net 232259.32 USD: Arbitrum W1 469 sales/74 buys 223415.05, Ethereum W1 8328.46, BSC W1 -1022.90, Polygon 660.55, Base 800.84, later Ethereum/BSC arbitrage legs +77.33; amount is net OPUL sold (394088351.286 - 26640537.406). BOBO 03-13/14 net 9252.90; DBD (Ethereum escrow 0xd5ca7e646e17083abf3cb983c632dba83509c02d net 3240303.63 moved through Polygon PoS predicate 0x40ec5b33f54e0e8a33a975908c5ba1c14e5bbbdf and sold on Polygon) net 1268.16; BUBBLE 09-22 net 2103.87. PEPE2.0 nets negative and is omitted. Not valued: 44482895 Arbitrum OPUL sent to exchange-style deposit EOAs (gas-funded by 0x6596da8b65995d5feacff8c2936f0b7a2051b0d0) 0xb4bfe93a732c47ab933d97d546e9da79e39cc128 and 0x059010fe6f9751f49cef887d06974c51dac8710c (swept to 0x0d0707963952f2fba59dd06f2b425ace40b492fe), 35418085 Ethereum OPUL parked at 0x8ae8635b03b3c515a0158bf3d0501f8dd611cf38, 6.05e9 BOBO released on 05-07, 1 Mog hop output redeemed on Avalanche and one 17.98 USDC output to Algorand. Total 399883.76 USD; realizedAt = last counted disposal on Base (1790073453).

limitations: OPUL sent to exchange deposit addresses or retained (about 80M across Arbitrum and Ethereum) has no onchain disposal and is not valued; the loss is an onchain lower bound.

The EIP-1967 slot still selects the same implementation at Avalanche block 96340251 and hop() was not disabled; campaigns after the scanned range (router txlist through block 95906406, redemption logs through each chain's head on 2026-09-28) are not included.
